invariants: ReviewDecision is exactly Python's review_decide set {approve, repair, escalate, retry_infrastructure, cancel}; no variant is added or renamed.
HandoffAuthority is opaque: its field is private and only the host constructs it (from its configured authority value); adapters compare, never mint.
The two external requests target the external-workflow control surface, NOT coding_tasks - their doc comments say so (the design's reconciliation note).
responsibilities: The decision-side request values: PlanDecideRequest, ReviewDecideRequest, RepairRequest, PublicationRetryRequest, HandoffRequest, and the two external requests.
ReviewDecision with as_str/parse round-trip, and the opaque HandoffAuthority capability value.
summary: Decision-side request values: plan/review/repair/publication intents, the bound-authority handoff, and the two external-workflow operations.
